docs.description:
Spacer that sets a Tree Item's nesting depth via the exposed depth property (00–10). Indent = depth × 16px, matching the 16px chevron slot.

Width is content-driven — each variant holds depth × 16px units and hugs them. This is deliberate: fixed-size variants do NOT resize when swapped inside a nested instance (Figma limitation). Add depth by adding units; never resize the variant frame or convert to fixed widths.

rules.reason: The leading dot is Figma's mark for a building block kept out of the assets panel (Tree Item nests it); in code the component is Tree Indent.
Bespoke on both platforms: a spacer, a row of depth units, which no stock control is. Tree Item (F6) composes it; decorative, since the tree's own semantics say the depth.
Each depth is a drawing of its own: depth 00 is an empty 0px frame with no auto layout, and each other depth a row of that many units, so every cell follows the depth.
One level of indent is 16px, "matching the 16px chevron slot", says the description: the width of Tree Item's chevron, an icon.sm, the same value.
